reference_sql:
SELECT customer_id, order_id, channel,
       LAST_VALUE(channel) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id
                                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_channel
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
  AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
alternatives:
WITH last_orders AS (  -- one row per order in the period, numbered within its customer from the latest
  SELECT customer_id, channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
)
SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.channel, l.channel AS last_channel
FROM orders o
JOIN last_orders l ON l.customer_id = o.customer_id AND l.rn = 1
WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
